review.evidence: Both nBASIS Teller (0xAD60d4...) and Manager (0x17767f...) return owner() = 0xa08a0dc... at Ethereum block 25295023. That address is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 confirmed via getOwners(), getThreshold(), modules(), guard storage slot, and masterCopy slot. No modules, no guard. Upgrade follow-up on 2026-07-21: the nBASIS token at 0x11113ff3a60c2450f4b22515cb760417259ee94b is a directly deployed BoringVault contract, not a proxy. The EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero on Ethereum block 25580348, Plume block 82434036, and Plasma block 27687550. The Ethereum bytecode-derived verified source/ABI has no upgradeTo or upgradeToAndCall entry point; administrative ownership and authority can change permissions and vault parameters but cannot replace the deployed mint-critical bytecode. Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nBASIS supply to portfolio assets was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the owner Safe controls issuance authorization without an independent cap, and issuer-operated NAV data is not independent whole-supply reconciliation or prudential supervision. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: Nest's live positions, price, NAV, vault, flow-of-funds, and terms pages remain issuer-operated, and no reserve-attestor report was found that independently reconciles total nBASIS liabilities across deployments. Wave 1 reconciliation review 2026-08-15: Nest's official live positions endpoint publishes nBASIS portfolio holdings and supplyByChain for the shared vault address, while the accountant price-update endpoint publishes the current hub/spoke share price; Nest's issuer-operated feed therefore continuously reconciles total nBASIS share liabilities (supplyByChain × current share price) to the vault portfolio, although no independent attestor or prudential supervisor is identified.
